title: [Feature]: Regex Multiview Building
description:
### What problem does this solve?

Event channels come and go, and can't be reliably or reasonably selected by the dropdown.

### Proposed solution

Allow a type selector of classic/regex to each multi view (different fields, refresh plugins to change up) - regex dynamically grabs channels that match a regex pattern, up to the limit configured (ie 4) so that we don't go insane. audio selection on regex type should either be FIRST matched, LOWEST channel number, or ALL.
